title: Tuna-2: Pixel Embeddings Beat Vision Encoders
summary: A native unified multimodal model from Meta AI that performs both visual understanding and generation directly from raw pixels. It replaces traditional vision encoders like CLIP or VAEs with a single transformer architecture using direct patch embeddings and rectified flow.
research_notes: Operates entirely in pixel space without a latent stage; demonstrates that large-scale pixel-level training can outperform models relying on pretrained encoders in fine-grained tasks.

evolution.summary: As of mid-2026, the project is a CVPR 2026 Highlight. Meta has released the code and a 'foundation checkpoint' where certain backbone layers are randomly re-initialized for policy reasons, requiring a short fine-tuning pass by users to achieve full performance.
